newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open lower.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open lower.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious were called to open lower Thursday after gold fell overnight in Europe although dealers there were not expecting any further sharp drop immediately.
Gold weakened this week after Fed Chairman Greenspan told Congress that low inflation and slowing growth removed the need for interest rate rises.
COMEX August gold was called $1.00 to $1.50 lower after closing Wednesday at $323.80 an ounce.
Gold was fixed in London this morning at $321.80, down from $324.90 at the Wednesday afternoon fix.
COMEX warehouse gold stocks fell 33,809 ounces to 883,196 ounces Wednesday, while COMEX silver stocks fell 693,282 ounces to 175,899,397 ounces.
COMEX September silver was called 2.0 to 3.0 cents below Wednesday's close of $4.295 after trading from $4.295 to $4.26 on ACCESS.
NYMEX October platinum was called $2.00 to $2.50 lower after finishing Wednesday at $408.20, with NYMEX September palladium expected to open down $1.50 to $2.00 from the previous close of $179.50.
